entries.summary: Liana gains a BIP77 payjoin receiver that adds one confirmed wallet coin to the sender's transaction, picked by try_preserving_privacy from a HashMap-ordered candidate list.
entries.notes: Receiver-only path. WIP, not draft. If try_preserving_privacy fails, it falls back to the first HashMap candidate, which can break UIH avoidance. Outputs are committed without substituting the receiver script. The contributed input's nSequence is ENABLE_RBF_NO_LOCKTIME, and the payjoin lib coerces it to the sender's value. The catalog's Liana uih2/utxo_order values appear to come from this PR. Supersedes the 'DO NOT MERGE' POC #1806, which is not listed.

traits.after: the grouped pass runs only if the normal selection spends some but not all UTXOs of an address; otherwise the normal selection's inputs are kept
traits.evidence: src/wallet/spend.cpp CreateTransaction: `... && !coin_control.m_avoid_partial_spends && txr_ungrouped.has_partial_spend)`; master use_aps check at spend.cpp:1486 `txr_grouped->fee <= txr_ungrouped.fee + wallet.m_max_aps_fee`

entries.summary: When the normal coin selection leaves no address partially spent, the wallet keeps that input set instead of sometimes switching to the address-grouped selection, which can change how many and which inputs a transaction has.
entries.notes: Default send path. The on-chain effect is indirect (input count/selection) and probably small; the PR mainly fixes over-reporting of APS use (issue #25150).

traits.evidence: src/script/sign.cpp SignTaproot: `if (taproot_keypath_only) spenddata.scripts.clear();` ... `// Key path signing failed. In keypath-only mode, stop here ... if (taproot_keypath_only) return false;`

entries.summary: Adds an option so taproot wallets with script-path fallbacks (e.g. MuSig2 2-of-2 with a timelocked backup) never broadcast a script-path spend by accident, keeping the spend a 64-byte key-path signature on chain.
entries.notes: Opt-in: keypath_only option (default false) on send, sendall, walletcreatefundedpsbt, walletprocesspsbt and descriptorprocesspsbt. Only matters for taproot descriptors that have script leaves.
